prompt: In the style of Dungeons & Dragons official book illustration — high quality, high fidelity, digitally painted: A group of eight adventurers — seen mostly from behind or in silhouette, generic and indistinct — stand at the base of Kir Sabal, looking upward in awe. They are small against the scale of the cliff. Some point upward, others shield their eyes against the light. They are diverse in shape and gear but none are the focus. High above them, on the uppermost balcony of Kir Sabal, stands Princess Mwaxanare — a young Chultan woman in layered robes with gold and beaded adornments, small but commanding against the sky. Her posture is composed and regal, gazing down at the newcomers with quiet authority. Kir Sabal towers behind and above her: a clifftop monastery built into a sheer misty mountain face, with a grand golden dome at the peak, terraced white stone dwellings descending on wooden scaffolding and rope bridges, and waterfalls cascading down the rock beside it. Aarakocra — eagle-headed bird-people with large wingspans — circle the cliff face in the warm updrafts. Late afternoon light cuts through jungle mist. The adventurers are in shadow. Mwaxanare is in the light.
